view_frame: Front view (XZ plane) displays the vase silhouette. The vertical axis is Z (height), and the horizontal axis is X (width). The part is axisymmetric about the Z axis. The base rests at Z=0.

features.evidence: Single silhouette outline showing a vase shape with a flared rim, narrow neck, and wide belly. User notes specify a hollow vessel with 4mm wall and floor thickness.

connections: The outer profile and inner profile are connected at the rim (Z=120) and the floor (Z=4) to form a single closed loop for the revolve operation.
edit_rules: Changing wall_thickness or floor_thickness requires recalculating the inner profile vertices (r_inner = r_outer - thickness).
Changing the overall height requires scaling all Z coordinates of the profile vertices.
Changing the base_radius requires updating the first and last vertices of the outer and inner profiles respectively.
unresolved: Exact radii for the base, belly, neck, and rim are not dimensioned in the drawing; ASSUMED values based on the 120mm height constraint are used.
The specific curvature of the vase body is approximated by straight segments between key control points (base, belly, neck, rim) due to lack of spline data.
